modalities.evidence: simultaneous positron emission tomography (PET) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans

output.population: 18 healthy controls and 24 inter-ictal, temporal lobe epilepsy patients
output.summary: Simultaneous FDG-PET and MRI in healthy controls and inter-ictal temporal lobe epilepsy patients, measuring cerebral glucose metabolism and relative oxygen consumption to compute relative oxygen-glucose index maps.
